description: This PHP class 'EmployeeReportController' manages the generation and display of employee reports within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller to render appropriate Vue components based on request parameters, specifically handling report IDs and names.

classes.name: EmployeeReportController
classes.description: Controller for handling employee report views; renders report components based on request parameters.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Returns an instance of ReportGeneratorService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering based on request attributes, specifically the report ID.
